source: Coefficients, withholding rates, dispensa threshold, and the justification-rule structure are taken directly from SALARY_CALCULATOR_SPEC.md §4.3/§4.5, cross-checked against the PwC check case (€40,000 gross art151, €1,412.91 expenses -> taxable €30,000, shortfall 0): justified = max(fixedDeduction, max(0, ssPaid - ssExcessThresholdPct*gross)) + declaredExpenses must reach requiredPct*gross (€6,000) — confirmed exactly, since 4587.09 + 1412.91 = 6000.00. The SS-excess mechanic (only the portion of SS contributions exceeding 10% of gross counts toward justification, art. 31º-A CIRS) was confirmed via search summary, not a raw CIRS text fetch — moderate confidence. New-activity reduction's extra real-world condition (doesn't apply if the activity was closed < 5 years before reopening) is not modeled — no input field captures a 'restarted activity' case in v1.
